blurb: Enjoy a relaxing getaway at Gettysburg Campground, located just 3 miles from the heart of historic Gettysburg, PA. Bordered by the beautiful Marsh Creek, select from one of our 200+ RV sites, cottages and cabins or dedicated tent area all shaded by tall trees. Enjoy the amenities and activities on site or explore the expansive Gettysburg area.
